selection_rules.strong_match_IBC: IBC and both model Dice >= 0.65; select median mean Dice
selection_rules.strong_match_IGM: IGM and both model Dice >= 0.65; select median mean Dice
selection_rules.partial_match_IBC: IBC, both models overlap GT, mean Dice 0.25-0.55; select median mean Dice
selection_rules.partial_match_IGM: IGM, both models overlap GT, mean Dice 0.25-0.55; select median mean Dice
selection_rules.off_target_FP: IGM, GT-positive slice, and combined off-target count above the global test-slice 75th percentile; select median off-target count
selection_rules.missed_undersegmented: IGM, GT area >=25 pixels, and at least one model has a missed GT component; select median GT area
